patterns.name: Turbopack PostCSS panic in CI
patterns.root_cause: Turbopack has known PostCSS serialization bugs with function-based Tailwind plugins. Production builds must use Next.js webpack mode.
patterns.fix_strategy: Change the build script in the affected site's package.json from 'next build' to 'next build --webpack'

patterns.name: CSP blocking scripts in production
patterns.root_cause: The Content Security Policy in next.config.ts is missing a required directive or source. Scripts that work in dev (where CSP is relaxed) fail silently in production.
patterns.fix_strategy: Add the required source or directive to the Content-Security-Policy header in next.config.ts. Common fixes: add domain to connect-src for API calls, or add specific script sources to script-src.

patterns.name: Tailwind scanning node_modules via ** glob
patterns.root_cause: A content glob using ** descends into node_modules causing Tailwind to scan thousands of files. The glob packages/themes/**/*.{ext} is the known offender.
patterns.fix_strategy: Replace ** globs in tailwind.config.ts with scoped globs: use packages/themes/*/*.{ext} and packages/themes/*/components/**/*.{ext} instead of packages/themes/**/*.{ext}

patterns.name: Theme token classes undefined at runtime
patterns.root_cause: The Tailwind plugin is not correctly calling addBase (for CSS custom properties) and addUtilities (for utility class→variable mappings). Theme tokens are only available when both are applied.
patterns.fix_strategy: Verify packages/theme-system/tailwind-plugin.ts calls both plugin.addBase() with :root CSS custom properties AND plugin.addUtilities() with the token utility classes. Both calls are required.

patterns.name: CI fails after site directory rename
patterns.root_cause: Renaming a site directory changes the workspace package name. The pnpm lockfile references the old name and pnpm install --frozen-lockfile (used in CI) will fail until the lockfile is regenerated.
patterns.fix_strategy: Run 'pnpm install' locally (without --frozen-lockfile) to regenerate the lockfile, then commit the updated pnpm-lock.yaml file.

patterns.name: Fonts silently missing in production
patterns.root_cause: CSS @import url() for Google Fonts is silently ignored by Next.js/PostCSS pipeline. The font loads in dev but not in production builds.
patterns.fix_strategy: Remove the @import url() from globals.css and add a <link> tag directly in the site's app/layout.tsx <head> section instead.
